title: Stage 1 Constraint Extraction Output
description: Cleaned intent + structured constraints extracted from a spoken system description. Stage 1 of the Speakspec pipeline. Every field is required; emit null or empty array where a value is genuinely absent rather than omitting the key.

intent_summary.description: 200-400 word cleaned restatement of what the developer wants to build, with filler, false starts, and tangents removed. Plain prose. No markdown headers.

core_intent.description: One sentence: the single thing this system is for.

analogies.description: Comparisons the speaker used ('like Notion but for X'). High-signal constraint indicators. Empty array if none.

comparison.description: The analogy as spoken, e.g. 'like Stripe for healthcare'.

implication.description: What this analogy implies about the architecture.

named_components.description: Specific systems, services, or parts the speaker explicitly named.

constraints.description: Exactly the constraint categories Speakspec tracks. Include every category that was stated OR can be reasonably inferred. Mark each with source.

value.description: The extracted constraint value. For language_preference, this MUST be null-equivalent ('none stated') unless the speaker explicitly named a language.

source.description: 'stated' = speaker said it explicitly. 'inferred' = derived from context. language_preference may ONLY be 'stated'; never infer a language preference.

open_questions.description: Things a senior architect would need answered that the speaker did not address. Drives the architecture's low-confidence flags downstream.

interview_questions.description: EXACTLY 2 to 4 clarifying questions, each specific to THIS system. Never generic. Never ask 'what language do you want'. Each must target a gap that materially changes the architecture.

why_it_matters.description: Which architecture decision this answer would change.
